subject: oddly-colored wall
text: Bombing the oddly-colored wall on the sandstone platform across the Lava Cavern reveals a door.

evidence.quote: Jump up onto it and use a Bomb on the oddly-colored wall to reveal a door.  Go through it.

subject: switch
text: Stepping on the switch in Prison Corridor #2 opens the prison cell directly in front.

evidence.quote: Run forward and step on the switch to open the prison cell directly in front of you.

subject: Lava Cavern
text: The north door of the Lava Cavern is to the right when exiting Prison Corridor #2.

evidence.quote: Head to the door on the north side of the room and go through it.  It's the door to the right as you come out of the Prison Corridor #2.

subject: log bridge
text: Sliding down the steep log bridge leads inside the cage, which can be climbed to reach platforms above and below.

evidence.quote: Run forward, and you will slide down a steep log bridge to the inside of the cage that takes up the predominant portion of the room.  Grab onto the wall of this cage and climb to it's top level.

subject: massive block
text: Pushing the massive block off the east sandstone pillar onto the erupting lava column allows it to serve as an elevator to the upper level door.

evidence.quote: On the east sandstone pillar, there is a massive block.  Get behind this block and push it off the ledge, onto the huge column of lava that periodically bursts in the middle of the room.  Jump down and stand on the block, and use it as an elevator to reach the upper level the next time the lava column erupts.

subject: Fire Slug
text: Defeat Fire Slugs by aggressive attacking, raising your Shield if the slug expands into a column-shape.

evidence.quote: Defeat the Fire Slug by attacking it aggressively (put up your Shield if it expands into a large column-shape; it's about to attack if it does).

subject: stone block
text: Push the stone block into the track below and pull it into position on the floor's carved stone face.

evidence.quote: Push the stone block off the ledge (it can only be pushed one way) so that it lands in the stone track below.  Jump down and get in front of the block, and pull it backwards into position on the stone face carved into the floor.

subject: Diamond Switch
text: Dropping a bomb off the cliff near the Diamond Switch activates it and temporarily removes the flame pillar around the wire wall.

evidence.quote: Drop a bomb off the cliff so that it lands near the Diamond Switch, and quickly climb onto the ledge behind you.  The bomb's explosion will activate the switch, temporarily removing the pillar of flames that surrounds the wire wall.  Climb up this new wire wall to the top level, and go through the door at the top.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: Bombing the hollow wall in the Boulder Maze alcove reveals a Gold Skulltula that yields a token.

evidence.quote: Use a Bomb to destroy the left side of the wall (it isn't discolored, but if you strike it with your sword it sounds hollow).  Kill the Gold Skulltula on the other side and take it's token.

subject: Boulder Maze perimeter
text: Following the perimeter of the Boulder Maze keeping your right side to the wall leads to an alcove with a door.

evidence.quote: Again keeping your right side to the wall, follow the perimeter of the room.  You'll reach another small alcove with a door inside it.  Go through it.

subject: chest
text: Stepping on the switch in Prison Corridor #3 frees a Goron whose chest contains a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Run down the hall and step on the switch to free the Goron.  Speak with the Goron, then open his chest to get another Small Key.

subject: Goron
text: Stepping on the switch at the dead end of the Boulder Maze opens a cell where a Goron gives Link a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Once you make it around to the far left side of the room, you will happen across a Goron's prison cell which is at the end of a dead end in the maze.  Step on the switch in front of the cell to open it, and speak with the Goron inside.  Take his key.

subject: Boulder Maze locked door
text: Return along the Boulder Maze perimeter to unlock and pass through the locked door.

evidence.quote: Return to the locked door we passed earlier and go through it.

subject: Silver Eye
text: Shooting the Silver Eye on the wall with an arrow unlocks the sealed right door in the Narrow Span Room.

evidence.quote: Shoot the Silver Eye on the wall with an arrow to unlock the sealed door on the right from where you enter.

subject: chest
text: A chest to the right inside the Lava Curtain Room contains the Dungeon Map.

evidence.quote: Look to the right as you enter to find a chest which contains the Dungeon Map.

subject: Narrow Span Room
text: Enter the locked door on your right upon returning to the Narrow Span Room from the Lava Curtain Room.

evidence.quote: Enter the locked door on your right as you come out from the Lava Curtain room.

subject: wire platforms
text: Crossing the three wire platforms while dodging the rising lava curtain leads to sandstone steps and the upper left door.

evidence.quote: Run all the way along the wire platform (the curtain moves slowly and is easy to dodge), and jump across to the next wire platform at the gap.  Keep running along the new wire platform, jump onto a third wire platform, and jump again onto the large sandstones steps on the other side of the platform.  Climb to the top of the stairs and go through the door on the left.

subject: switch
text: Stepping on the small platform switch on top of the Boulder Maze opens a cell door on the far side of the room.

evidence.quote: Look to the left once more to see a small platform with a switch.  Jump out to the switch and step on it.  A cell door on the far side of the room will open, revealing another Goron.

subject: chest
text: Opening the chest inside the Goron's cell on top of the Boulder Maze yields a Small Key.

evidence.quote: Speak with the Goron and open his chest to get another Small Key.

subject: huge gash
text: Dropping a bomb onto the huge gash in the floor reveals a massive pit that Link can drop down.

evidence.quote: Drop a bomb onto this gash, and the explosion will reveal a massive pit.  Drop down to the bottom of this pit.

subject: chest
text: Opening the chest in the Goron's cell yields another Small Key.

evidence.quote: Speak with the Goron and open the chest in his cell to get another Small Key.
